question: Approve the local task-progress design for implementation on a separately approved committed border baseline?

artifacts.summary: One optional skill reads local tasks; each story has one explicit complete required-task declaration, current done states are re-read, and missing or inconsistent mappings remain unverified. The independent drawing core receives derived metadata only; all-done means pending delivery acceptance. Real CLI/archive/pagination and readback falsifiers support this design; product implementation is pending. Proposed stops: 10 files, 700 changed lines, 260 reader/CLI lines. The validated 12-file border commit needs its separate Captain approval before an isolated dependent build.
